scripts.typecheck:runtime: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.typecheck:source: bun run check:bindings && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.production.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.development.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.prepare:source: bun run scripts/generate-presentation.ts --prepare-assets && bun run scripts/check-bindings.ts --prepare
scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p .nddev-reports && bun run test:organizations && bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium && node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=.nddev-reports/web.xml scripts/offline-worker.test.ts
